name: LoveWatch AI
tagline: AI companion chat with 5-second video replies
description: LoveWatch is an AI companion chat that answers with video as well as text. Pick one of four preset AI characters (Mia, Leo, Leila or Noah), talk about your day, and ask for a five-second video reply with their face and voice. The clip opens in the same chat, so you can watch it and reply right away. Text chat and your own voice input cost no credits; voice replies and videos use media credits (a video is 20 credits). You can say hello without an account, then start a 7-day free trial with no card required; after the trial, five daily texts stay free. Paid plans (from $9.99/month) add monthly media credits and one weekly "day in their life" video. These are short video messages, not live video calls. Chats are private by default, and saved memories can be viewed and deleted. Custom character creation is currently unavailable. Works in the browser on phone and desktop, no app download. For users 18+.
